initial.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: standalone transparent pixel-art navigation emblem for an approved personal portfolio.
Input image 1 is a reference website mockup. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the small emblem in its upper-left navigation: a coral triangular camping tent in front of a dark navy mountain silhouette with stepped pixel edges.

The user has approved this emblem. This task prepares its independent reusable asset, not a redesign.
Preserve the reference's compact silhouette and proportions: wide mountain group, one tallest peak behind the tent and smaller angular side peaks, coral tent in the foreground, narrow transparent gap/opening inside the tent. Dark navy ink approximately #102E3C and coral approximately #EB654F. Flat fills, hard crisp stair-step pixel edges, consistent pixel grid, no anti-aliased soft illustration, no outlines that are absent from the original.

Output ONE isolated emblem centered on a genuinely transparent canvas. The background, mountain gaps and open tent detail must be transparent alpha, NOT white or cream, NOT a checkerboard drawn in. Use generous master resolution around 1024x1024, with the emblem itself occupying about 85% of the canvas width and preserving its natural roughly 1.5:1 wide shape. Leave transparent padding. It must remain a simple recognizable small navbar icon after scaling.

Exclude ALL website content: no text, ALEJO, initials, buttons, CV, menu, landscape, decorative scene, lake, UI frame or watermark. No drop shadow, glow, gradients, texture, new symbols, sun, trees or additional peaks. Do not create a logo presentation board, variants, sizes sheet or mockup. Just the single selected tent-and-mountains emblem on transparent alpha.

dark navy mountain silhouette approximately #102E3C,
coral triangular foreground tent approximately #EB654F.
